provenance.reuse: Original articulated hierarchy and IK mathematics only. Independently authored adult silver-haired crowned queen, full opaque silver-blue fur-trimmed split-panel gown, fitted covered trousers and silver boots, anatomical RIGHT crystal staff. No official sprite copying or finished actor recolor. Fourteen NW/SE ready boundaries reuse this actor own idle0 by exact raw visible RGBA/full alpha and equal anchors; substantive phases are independently rendered.
provenance.gait: Seven repaired directions use real connected hip/knee/ankle movement, opposite support and passing phases. SW topology was resolved by a continuous blue-near/orange-far diagnostic then material-only restoration; NW/NE/E/SE use eight-phase colored ownership diagnostics followed by material-only native restoration. Diagnostic colors are never runtime pixels. S and W preserve their passed chronological pose sources. Original N is retained with explicit gown occlusion uncertainty.
provenance.sourceLayout: Original death source omitted E, repaired with eight genuine native poses; original S attack and SW linked-actor extraction repaired. Original walk/hit faint-alpha bridging was segmented at verified64 threshold. Every active repair uses inspected genuine pose count and actual cell layout; no duplicate padding. Current sourceFrames is the authoritative active mapping.
provenance.sourceHistory: provenance.sources retains append-only candidate/repair history, including superseded held attempts. That history does not imply every historical file passed. Only current sourceFrames and final runtime clips are source accepted; raw rejected/uncertain diagnostics remain preserved for provenance.
